variants.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: ONE transparent anime game character portrait, part of a matched ten-portrait set. Image 1 is the authoritative ORIGINAL edit target for pose, expression, view direction, character silhouette and crop. Image 2 is the approved MODERN style reference. Apply Image 2's refined contemporary anime rendering (fine varied linework, layered hair with selective highlights, polished cel shading mixed with soft gradients, naturally constructed fabric folds, warm skin shading) to Image 1. Match the established character face design and restrained detailing; not 3D, not photorealistic, not chibi. Do not copy the pose or facial expression from Image 2. Anatomy rule: normal hand and finger proportions, natural knuckles and bends, fingers not unnaturally elongated, five digits per hand when visible, middle finger about 75–85% of palm length, thumb shorter, pinky shorter; preserve the ORIGINAL gesture and do not expose fingers hidden by sleeves. Keep source costume and expression faithfully; modernization changes drawing quality rather than character identity. One portrait only, no montage, no side-by-side, no labels or text. Genuine transparent alpha background; no opaque white/black background or checkerboard, no scene, ground, shadow outside character, aura, weapons or floating props. Fully show head bow and all parts that are visible in original with small safe transparent margins. Keep crop type as original, upper-body remains upper-body and full-body remains full-body. Detailed variant constraints: Subject: Hakurei Reimu. Preserve red-white shrine-maiden costume of this particular game: large red head bow with delicate white edging, black shoulder-length hair with bangs and red-white ornaments tying side locks, red irises when eyes open, red neck ribbon, red vest with white border details, voluminous white sleeves, red long flowing skirt wherever visible. Match the approved Reimu's face and hair styling. No costume swap to short skirt, no added gohei, no new accessories. Upper-body portrait cropped at upper hips, both arms behind back, upright relaxed three-quarter pose. Eyes OPEN red, small closed-mouth mild smile, alert confident neutral brows. NO raised hand. Preserve torso crop, do not invent legs.
